title: ConversationQueryRequest
description: Schema for incoming natural language queries to the Layer 3 Conversational Analytics engine.

session_id.description: Optional conversation session ID. If omitted, a new session is initialized.

user_query.description: The user's natural language input string.

user_role.description: Authenticated user security role for markings and RBAC enforcement.

context_filters.description: Optional domain or temporal filter constraints.
